show.description: Mistaken for a waitress, a powerful woman hides her true identity behind a humble smile. As misunderstandings, rivalry, and romance unfold, love begins to blur the lines of power. When the truth is revealed, the underestimated woman rises as the unstoppable Sky Queen of a global empire.
